name: Letter House
source:
Daisy Gardener, Astral Mage and Steward-Class Witch, has been hired to aid an Exalt Witch- a title given to only the most powerful magi in history- who requires her fortune-telling services. She quickly learns there's more to being an Exalt than simply being powerful in reality, however- this Exalt Witch's power extends into dreams, and Daisy needs to rescue her from them.

A surreal horror visual novel, Letter House asks- what are your walls made of?

[From [url=https://pepperparker.itch.io/letter-house]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黛西·加德纳（Daisy Gardener），星界法师和管家级女巫，被雇佣来帮助一位需要她算命服务的至尊女巫——这个头衔只授予历史上最强大的法师。然而，她很快就了解到，成为尊者不仅仅是在现实中拥有强大的力量，这位尊者女巫的力量延伸到了梦境中，而黛西需要将她从梦中拯救出来。

《Letter House》是一部超现实恐怖视觉小说，它问你——你的墙是用什么做的？

[来自[url=https://pepperparker.itch.io/letter-house]Itch.io[/url]]
